title: Intelligence Stack Wiring — Route Everything Through Ollama + Obsidian
brief: Connect built-but-disconnected intelligence infrastructure: Qdrant vector memory, Obsidian persistence vault, Ollama compute layer, error-learning loop, 5 orphaned reasoning engines, CLAUDE.md/GSD/directive chunking. Result: ~80% session-token reduction + true cross-session/cross-PC persistence. Origin: 5-agent forge-audit identified that PRISM is 'architecturally complete but electrically disconnected' — Ollama runs 0 offloads/7days, Qdrant has no embedder, error capture has 5 silos, 5 highest-leverage reasoning engines are orphaned, only 27% of CLAUDE.md rules are auto-enforced.

units.title: Add 4 hooks for unforced CLAUDE.md rules
units.ship_notes: All 4 hook files now exist at .claude/hooks/. The 2 pre-existing (rtk-prefix-reminder.mjs, compact-interval-warning.mjs) were already shipped. The 2 newly added (2026-05-13): engine-digest-precheck.mjs (T1 PreToolUse Write/Edit on src/engines/*Engine.ts — fires only on CREATE not modify; uses Jaccard similarity over tokenized engine names with default threshold 0.6 against ENGINE_DIGEST.md). commit-format-validator.mjs (T3 PostToolUse Bash — extracts subject from -m double-quoted, single-quoted, or heredoc form, then validates against /^(\[MAIN\]\s+)?\[SCOPE-MS#\](\/U-ID)?: title$/ — Revert form also accepted). Both export pure functions for testing (tokenize/jaccard/findSimilarEngines for the first; isValidSubject/extractCommitSubject for the second). 44 vitest cases shipped covering input guards, threshold gating, regex variations, and integration of extracted-subject feeding back into validator. Both hooks are advisory (systemMessage, never block). Knobs: PRISM_ENGINE_DIGEST_PRECHECK=0 / PRISM_ENGINE_DIGEST_THRESHOLD=N / PRISM_COMMIT_FORMAT_VALIDATOR=0. Wiring into settings.json is a 2-line operator follow-on (one entry in PreToolUse Write matcher, one in PostToolUse Bash matcher) — files are present, behavior is correct, gates are advisory so partial wiring is graceful.

tool_integration_template.description: Standard process for absorbing a new tool/library/service into PRISM intelligence stack
steps: 1. Survey: does this tool replace something existing or fill a gap? (run /dedup)
2. Wrap: create an engine class wrapping the tool's API (mcp-server/src/engines/<Name>Engine.ts)
3. Expose: add dispatcher action (e.g., prism_dev:<verb>) with Zod schema (no z.any()!)
4. Test: round-trip test through dispatcher (not just engine singleton)
5. Hook: if there's an auto-trigger event, add to .claude/hooks/ with proper schema
6. Route: add domain to ollama-unified-semantic-router if Ollama can pre-classify
7. Persist: if state needed, write to H:/prism/state/ (NEVER to C:/)
8. Index: add to MEMORY.md + knowledge/wiki/ + ENGINE_DIGEST.md
9. Document: add 1-paragraph entry to CLAUDE.md (project-specific) or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global)
10. Mirror: ensure new files are on H: (per master-drive rule)
